items.quote: Kindly transfer the total within 21 days of the date of this invoice, quoting the invoice number.
items.computation: Invoice is dated 21 November 2026 (a Saturday). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, the day of the event (the invoice date) is not counted, so the 21-day period starts 22 November 2026. 21 days later lands on 12 December 2026 (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB), which is a Saturday. Under § 193 BGB, since the obligation is owed to the recipient (payment), the deadline moves to the next business day: Monday, 14 December 2026.
